prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Spectrum 1-4: page #F9F9FB, text #251F2D, accent #861D85, secondary surface #EFEAE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in EB Garamond and reading text in Cotham Sans; literary heading with understated sans text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 32px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
